data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 街角书店
data.description: 午后的街角书店里，麻衣换上茶棕灯芯绒外套、象牙白高领针织衫和藏蓝直筒长裤，倚着书架，双手托住刚选好的文集，用摊开的书页遮住唇边的笑。近处小展示台上摆着几本封面朝上的书与纸书签，木书架向后转进较窄的阅读过道，尽头可见店门磨砂玻璃。暖色吊灯从右上照亮书页断面、兔子发夹与外套纹理，书背间留出较暗缝隙——「没想到你也会对这种古典小说感兴趣……读完之后，要不要和我交换一下读后感？」
data.location: 街角书店文集书架旁，阅读过道延伸至磨砂玻璃店门
data.action: 倚着书架，双手托住打开的文集，让书页遮住唇边，望向画面外的同行者。
data.lighting: warm pendant light from the upper right on page edges and corduroy; dimmer shelf recesses
data.promptProse: Leaning against the shelf, Mai hides her smile behind the open book held in both hands and looks toward her off-frame companion. The upper-right pendant warms the page edges, rabbit clip and corduroy texture, leaving shelf recesses dark. Books and paper bookmarks lie on the foreground display; shelves turn into a narrow rear aisle ending at the frosted-glass door.
data.animaCaption: The open book hides her smile as she looks toward her off-frame companion beside the shelf.
